summary: Cul-de-sac kerb with parked cars, but homes 17-22 m away on this side.
reasons: Homes 17-22 m away on own side

drivers.seclusion: Houses on both sides; nearest on this section are 17 and 19 m away, with 11 m further along.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed cul-de-sac with a wide turning head; room for a van beside the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end street, so very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Three cars parked along this kerb, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 4% mean grade, 9.8% max further along
Witton Creek 4 m away, ground about 35-37 m so low flood risk
sun_shade: Open at the turning head, trees shade from the east and south.

best_section.where: Greenrigg Court east kerb around the turning head
